deskSetNodePortNote: Check the address and the port (usually {port}).

@deskSetNodePortNote.description: Settings > Node: error under the node picker when the typed node does not answer.

deskSetNodeListNote: Status from {site}; latency measured from this computer.

@deskSetNodeListNote.description: Settings > Node: footer under the node list. The status site's host name {site} stays as it is.

@deskSetNodeRowNotSetUp.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: not installed or never started.

@deskSetNodeRowStopped.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: switched off.

@deskSetNodeRowStarting.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: starting up.

@deskSetNodeRowSyncingPct.description: Status of the local node in the node picker while syncing. {percent} is a number with a percent sign, e.g. "42%".

@deskSetNodeRowStalled.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: sync stopped making progress.

@deskSetNodeRowFailed.description: Status of the local node in the node picker: could not run.

@deskSetNodeLocalInUse.description: Toast title after switching to the local node.

deskSetNodeLocalInUseText: It downloads the whole chain. Needs 5 GB free.

@deskSetNodeLocalInUseText.description: Toast text after switching to the local node.

@deskSetNodeLocalNode.description: Name of the node program on this computer, in the node picker and its field.

@deskSetNodeGroupComputer.description: Heading of the node picker group holding the local node.

@deskSetNodeServer.description: Settings > Node: row title, picker label and screen reader name.

deskSetNodeServerHint: The node the wallet reads the chain through and sends with.

@deskSetNodeServerHint.description: Settings > Node: hint under the Node server row.

@deskSetNodeChecking.description: Settings > Node: shown while a chosen node is checked.

@deskSetNodeBackground.description: Settings > Node: switch title and screen reader name.

deskSetNodeBackgroundHint: Closing the window keeps the node syncing. The app stays in the tray.

@deskSetNodeBackgroundHint.description: Settings > Node: hint under Sync in background.

@deskNodeSwitchConnecting.description: Desktop node switch: shown in the selected node field and the sidebar's Node status the moment the user picks a public node, until the wallet runs on it. {host} is the node's host name, kept as it is.

@deskNodeSwitchStarting.description: Desktop node switch: shown while the wallet switches to the built-in local node and the node starts.

@deskNodeSwitchStopping.description: Desktop node switch: shown after the wallet moved to a public node, while the built-in local node shuts down cleanly (its chain data is kept).

@deskNodeSwitchStoppingWord.description: Sidebar Node status word, one word: the built-in local node is shutting down after a switch to a public node.

@deskSetNodeConnection.description: Node page: heading of the node picker and its switches.

@deskSetNodeFailover.description: Node › Connection: switch that moves to the next working node when this one stops answering.

@deskSetNodeStatus.description: Node page: heading of what the node says of itself.
